# Ponyhof

> Ponyhof is a photo and video studio in Berlin. We photograph and film conferences and launches, and we make brand video and social content for companies and founders. We work in English and German.

Ponyhof shoots candid, documentary style event photos: people talking and listening, no posed lineups. Every event package includes reels. On a full day, a recap is online before the closing session. Use on the client's website and social channels is included; use in paid ads is priced separately. We are based in Berlin and travel across Germany and Europe.

Contact: alex@ponyhof.studio. We answer within 2 hours on workdays.

## Services

- [Event photography Berlin](https://ponyhof.studio/event-photography-berlin): conference and event photo and video. Three packages: Cover (4 hours, 60 photos, 3 reels, delivery within 48 hours), Live (full day, 120 photos, 4 reels, a 90 second film and a recap before the closing session) and Signature (full day with two operators, 120 photos, 6 reels and a 90 second film, delivery within 24 hours).
- [Commercial video Berlin](https://ponyhof.studio/commercial-video-berlin): reels and brand films for founders and local businesses. Founder packages: Portrait, Interview and Authority. Restaurant and cafe packages: Look, Story and Monthly.
- [Ponyhof auf Deutsch](https://ponyhof.studio/de): German overview of the studio.

## Work

- [GTM Tech Week Berlin 2026](https://ponyhof.studio/gtm-tech-week): event photography and short form video at a meetup for Europe's go to market community.
- [Rat für Migration](https://ponyhof.studio/rat-fuer-migration): official photography for a three day conference across several Berlin venues, including Humboldt University.
- [St. Pauli KICKZ 3x3](https://ponyhof.studio/kickz): built and ran the team's social channels for 10 months across the FIBA 3x3 circuit, from zero to nearly 3,000 followers and over 6 million organic Reels views.
- [Lovelee](https://ponyhof.studio/lovelee): content and growth for an independent artist, over 2.1 million organic views and more than 65,000 streams.
